protocol.task: Paired 6-DOF microquad simulated pursuit, same flight and 7mm insect for both LGMD variants
protocol.camera: 20 frames per second, 320x320 render, matched 160x160 retinal processing
protocol.frame_input: Direct log-brightness differences between consecutive images; independent ON and OFF
protocol.dvs_input: Simulated positive and negative log-contrast crossing event counts; independent ON and OFF; no grayscale frame supplied to DVS detector
protocol.circuit: ON/OFF-specific delayed retinotopic radial-expansion activity with lateral inhibition, feedforward inhibition, polarity competition and separate channel alarm thresholds
protocol.controller: Unchanged decoupled camera steering and 400ms predictive lead; alarm decisions are replayed and do not alter the flight
protocol.contact_rule: First entry into 2cm 3D separation; a correct basket alarm must occur within the preceding 200ms
protocol.use_of_truth: Only after prediction, in evaluator. Neural models have no distance, position, masks or collision time.
protocol.tuning: 10 development seeds (2026-2052); neural/basket thresholds selected for at most one false trigger on tuning runs; opponent competition of 0.8 was subsequently explored on the 20 development runs.
protocol.new_seed_eval: 3101-3110: generated after freezing all parameters and evaluated without retuning
protocol.limitations: Simulation-only, approximated binned DVS not an asynchronous hardware event camera; frame model uses camera brightness; simplified LGMD-inspired circuit not direct neurophysiological replication; benchmark is offline flight replay not physical interception
